captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a square vol-au-vent or cookie cutter featuring a double-walled design. It consists of a large outer square cutting wall, a smaller concentric inner square cutting wall, and a flat supporting frame at the base that connects them. The inner cutter is slightly shorter than the outer cutter, and both walls are thin and sharp for clean dough cutting.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric square pastry cutter in OpenSCAD with an option for an inner cutter to make vol-au-vents. Users should be able to configure the outer side length, outer height, wall thickness, inner cutter size difference, inner height offset, and the base frame width and thickness.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using a union of three main parts: a grip frame, an outer cutter, and an optional inner cutter. The grip frame is made by using difference() on a larger cube and a smaller central cutout cube, adjusted based on whether the inner cutter is enabled. The outer cutter is generated by subtracting a slightly smaller cube from a main cube to create thin walls. The inner cutter, if enabled, is created similarly with scaled-down dimensions and translated vertically to be slightly shorter than the outer cutter.
